column7: AWSSecretsManagerConnector.GetSecret returned success with "" when SecretString was present but empty ({"SecretString":""}) -- out.SecretString != nil is true for a pointer to an empty string, not just to real content; fixed by also requiring *out.SecretString != ""; found by FuzzAWSSMConnectorResponse (crasher 09de4b520b95a429, committed as a seed), fixed same PR; dedicated point test used as the proving test (not the fuzzer) so this claim has its own unambiguous test name, matching the connect-response-size-cap-aws-001/-azure-001 convention; see docs/findings/2026-09-20-FINDING-awssm-empty-secret-response.md
